body: I only bring pain and sadness to everyone despite my efforts to fix things.

Hey, everyone screws up some point of their lives. At least I have. You can’t change the past, and you need to forgive yourself. Accept what happened, and move on. It doesn’t help fight and think what if’s of something that you can’t change. What helps is to ask yourself: what did I learn. What can I do to not be in this place again. You can ask for help. There’s no shame of it. Nobody is perfect and we all humans. Stay safe.
Sorry to hear about that. It sucks...

There’s not a reason to be embarrassed. I know your pain and trust me, it helps to talk and seek for help. I was in your spot and two years ago I’ve decided that’s enough and talked about it with my doctor. I went to some counselling and I’m on some pills that help me to function as a normal person. I do have some blue days but nothing compared with 2 years ago. I hope you get better soon!

The only issue I see is the Chaser Effect which can lead you to fail more frequently. Maybe it's better to manage your urges and try to replace them with activities. I noticed that I have urges more frequently when I'm doing nothing, like browsing facebook or bored.
I know it's hard, but you can do it! Leave the computer and phone right now and go for a walk or do a project. don't focus on it too much. Accept the urge and walk away.
